Process About Contact See if I qualify
Process About Contact See if I qualify
Security & Selection

Every Connection Begins With Trust.

Zafira maintains a highly selective evaluation process. Because authentic, high-value experiences require safety, intentionality, and rigorous verification.

STEP 01

Initial Application

The journey begins with a discreet digital application. We review your personal information to ensure our environments align with your aspirations.

This first qualification stage is completely confidential. We evaluate intentionality and basic lifestyle compatibility before inviting you to proceed.

STEP 02

Preliminary Review

At no cost. We read your application and, only if your profile can move forward, we explain the next step: the evaluation and verification.

EVALUATION & VERIFICATION · USD 400: covers the study, the evaluation and the background verification. It does not reserve a place and is not part of the programme (USD 13,000); it is non-refundable once the evaluation begins.

All participants are carefully reviewed. We verify identity, civil status, and global records to ensure an environment of absolute trust.

STEP 03

Private Consultation

Following verification, you will schedule a discreet, one-on-one consultation with a dedicated Zafira advisor.

This elegant interaction allows us to evaluate your goals, expectations, and lifestyle alignment. We provide personalized guidance to ensure that our selective network is the right fit for your future.

STEP 04

Profile Approval

Zafira remains a highly exclusive environment. Not every application is accepted.

Once your consultation and background checks are complete, selected applicants receive formal approval. Quality, authenticity, and refined character matter deeply to us. This ensures that every individual you meet shares a comparable standard of excellence.

STEP 05

Event & Program Access

Upon approval, and only if you decide to continue, you make a single payment for the programme.

$13,000 USD

This single payment covers the personalised search, verification, private introductions and the Cartagena programme.

STEP 06

The Cartagena Programme

A private, accompanied programme in Cartagena: a welcome, organised meetings with the candidates selected for you, cultural activities and a closing dinner.

Zafira’s team is with you throughout the official dates. The final agenda, venue and dates are confirmed in writing beforehand.

ZAFIRA • PRIVATE EXPERIENCE

Welcome to the
Zafira Experience

Exclusive Private Event • Cartagena • October or November 2026 (dates to be confirmed)

Not another dating event. A private, invitation-only experience where exceptional men meet distinguished, feminine, and accomplished women in an environment designed for authentic connection.

Exact dates and the application deadline will be confirmed before places open.

Apply for Your Private Invitation Discover the Experience ↓

Begin Your Evaluation

Take the first step toward an elevated reality. Submit your initial application today.

Request Private Access
Privacy Policy Terms & Conditions Cancellations & Refunds About Contact
